items.title: AI glasses face their first major government crackdown
items.rationale: Follow-up with a concrete new government action: Norway will legislate a temporary ban on AI glasses in parks, beaches, schools and kindergartens and convene an expert group for permanent rules (first national-level crackdown).
items.excerpt: Norway's government said Monday it will introduce a law for a temporary ban on AI glasses in places such as parks, beaches, schools and kindergartens, and set up an expert group to draft permanent rules.

items.title: OpenAI launches text watermarks in the EU to meet the AI Act
items.rationale: Regulation visibly changing a product: OpenAI ships 'textGrain' watermarking in ChatGPT/Codex in the EU to comply with AI Act transparency rules, EU-only for now.
items.excerpt: OpenAI is launching 'textGrain' text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex in the EU to meet EU AI Act transparency requirements, but says it won't be the global default yet; Anthropic made a similar move.

items.title: Sen. Bernie Moreno sends letter urging Anthropic's Dario Amodei to drop 'alarmist' AI commentary
items.rationale: Concrete new action from Congress: a sitting senator formally wrote to Anthropic's CEO on Monday objecting to its AI-risk messaging ahead of the expected IPO - lawmakers now pressing labs directly on how they talk about AI risk (write neutrally).
